_comment: S.S. Aqua, Olivine side. Oak upgrades the Pokédex.
0: Welcome to the Fast Ship S.S. Aqua.\r...Except the engine crew on vacation.\nIn Cancun. On the company card.
1: Welcome to the Fast Ship S.S. Aqua.\nCan I see your S.S. Ticket?\r
2: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} tried to show the\nS.S. Ticket...\r...But there ain't no Ticket!\r
3: My bad...\rOne more stowaway wouldn't make a\ndifference. We already got four.\rBut rules is rules.\nNo Ticket, no boat. Swim, kiddo.
5: Aight, you got a Ticket!\rWe leavin' soon. Get on board quick!\nLife jackets is under the seat. Probably.\r
6: What? You ALREADY showed me the Ticket.\nI got a memory. Barely, but I got one.
7: Welcome to the S.S. Aqua!\rYour Ticket is...right there.\nCome on through.\r
8: Runnin' a ship every day WEAR you out!\fIt ain't runnin' today. I'm tired.\rIt leave for Vermilion on Mondays and\nFridays! If I feel like it!
